Pool cabanas in Larkspur Vale

Pool cabanas in Larkspur Vale, with the sunset included.

Check availability
The short answerOur cabanas sit along the east side of the pool, facing the sunset, with covered shade for the afternoon. Each one seats a small group and can be reserved ahead for hotel guests. Availability changes by season.
Reserve aheadOnline or at the front desk
ShadeCovered afternoon shade

SeasonalHours change with the season

Who it suits

Couples and small groups who want a reserved spot by the pool for an afternoon or a celebration.

What to expect

Reserve your cabana, check in at the pool desk and settle in. Pool hours and cabana pricing change by season, so the current details are shown when you book.
